name: string-typo-match
description: Match typing errors against candidate strings with weighted omissions, swaps, and explainable ambiguity

scripts.devtest: c8 npm run unit && npm run examples && npm run lint
scripts.pretest: npm run lect:check && npm run build

features.summary: A `leven` alternative for matching human typing errors against your own dictionary, with optional keyboard awareness and explained suggestions.
items: Treat a missing chunk as one typo, with limits on how much can disappear.
Recognise missed keys, extra characters, repeats, substitutions, and adjacent swaps.
Enable QWERTY weighting or supply your own keyboard map.
Tune error costs and allow one or two typo events.
Keep exact matches, rank fuzzy suggestions, and flag ambiguity.
Match Unicode code points; explain edits with original-string offsets.
Prepare dictionaries once; track progress and completion statistics.
Get TypeScript types, ESM, and a standalone browser script without dependencies.
